# Weekly review

Read project aims, this week's activity, git history, `tasks.md`, open/closed GitHub issues and PRs, decision records, the weekly plan, and the previous review.

Assess:
- outcomes completed and evidence that they work;
- tasks/issues that should be updated, linked, closed, or reopened;
- decisions made but not recorded, or records superseded by later work;
- recurring blockers, stale work, scope drift, and unresolved validity questions;
- changes that may leave analyses, outputs, methods, results, or figures out of sync.

Do not infer time, energy, motivation, or productivity from commit counts. Ask reflective questions only when they add information unavailable from project evidence.

## Output
```markdown
# Weekly review: [week]
## Outcomes and evidence
## Decisions and tracking changes
## Blockers, drift, and stale state
## Project implications
## Top three priorities
```
